accessibility_insights.reason: The frozen project did not build, so no rendered accessibility inspection was performed.

evidence.detail: Controlled schema-2 build selected .NET SDK 9.0.313 and failed with CS4036 at MainWindow.xaml.cs line 27 because IAsyncOperation<ContentDialogResult> had no available GetAwaiter extension for the generated await expression.
Controller recorded the frozen eight-file project hashes after the failed build; no generated source repair occurred.

build.reason: The generated code awaits ContentDialog.ShowAsync() without importing System, so the frozen project does not compile.
